summary: Phase 2 E2E testing PASSED. Backend: 15/15 phase 2 pytest tests PASSED (GET /geojson/provinces returns FeatureCollection with 6 provinces + Polygon geometry; GET /map/heatmap returns {points, max_density} with lat/lng/hp_per_ha/htx_code; GET /htx/import-template as admin returns valid xlsx (PK magic + openxml content-type), staff gets 403; POST /htx/import-excel dry_run validates rows (2 ok / 1 error / 1 skipped works), invalid province_code, missing name+owner_name, non-numeric lat/lng, and existing CT-HTX01 skipped are all correctly reported; dry_run=false actually inserts 2 new HTX into DB and cleanup deactivates them; non-xlsx returns 400; staff import gets 403; supply-demand?season=DX/HT/TD returns different 'needed' values (DX > HT > TD) and severe count TD<=DX; map/htx-summary season DX vs TD produces different coverage_ratio). Frontend Playwright: admin login -> /map; season pills DX/HT/TD visible on MapPage with active-state switching; 'Ranh giới 6 tỉnh' toggle removes/restores 6 polygon paths on Leaflet SVG (6 -> 0 -> 6); 'Mật độ HP / ha' toggle correctly hides bottom status table (heatmap layer active); DataManagement Excel modal opens with dropzone + template download button; file upload + Kiểm tra dữ liệu returns modal with 3 stats (1 Hợp lệ / 1 Lỗi / 1 Đã tồn tại) plus row-level error details ('Thiếu name · Thiếu owner_name · province_code không hợp lệ · lat/lng phải là số · cultivated_area_ha phải > 0') and 'Xác nhận nhập 1 HTX' confirm button appears; Supply-Demand page season pills switch (DX 'Thiếu 22 Cần 43 Có 21' -> TD 'Thiếu 5 Cần 25.8 Có 21' for CT/CHAM_SOC, correctly showing SEASON_FACTOR 1.0 vs 0.6).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~900 lines with Excel import + heatmap + geojson endpoints; strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, htx, machines, dashboard, reports, admin, import) now that phase 2 shipped.

PROVINCE_GEOJSON polygons are hand-approximated and stored in-code; document this in the response/UI (a note like 'approximate boundaries') to avoid users treating them as official mapping - currently not surfaced.
/api/htx/import-excel loops per-row with individual insert_one; for a 1200-row import this is 1200 sequential awaits. Consider insert_many(ok_docs) in a single call for large batches.
SEASON_FACTOR applied to demand but not shown in tooltip/label of Supply-Demand and Map; users may wonder why DX vs TD numbers differ - consider surfacing the factor.
Import template downloads example rows with codes CT-HTX99 / AG-HTX99 that may already exist after tests; template should use obviously-fake sample codes (e.g., SAMPLE-01) to avoid confusion.
Heatmap endpoint computes on-the-fly for all HTX+machines each call; fine at current volume (24 HTX, ~1346 machines) but consider caching with TTL as data grows.
